meals.strMeal: Taco Bell Cheesy Fiesta Potatoes – Easy Copycat Recipe
meals.strInstructions:
Wash and peel potatoes.  Cut potatoes into ½ inch to ¾ inch cubes.  Rinse potatoes off, and pat dry with a paper towel.

Heat oil in a deep fryer to 350 degrees.

Prepare seasoned flour for potatoes by combining flour, onion powder, garlic powder, paprika, and cayenne pepper in a medium-sized bowl.

Drop potato chunks into the flour, and coat well.  Shake off excess seasoned flour before placing into the deep fryer.

Deep fry for about 10 to 12 minutes or until the potatoes are golden brown.  Remove potatoes from the fryer, and drain on wire rack.

Heat cheese sauce, pour 2 ounces of cheese sauce over potatoes, and top with 1 ounce of sour cream.
meals.strDescription: Recreate Taco Bell's famous Cheesy Fiesta Potatoes at home! Crispy seasoned potato cubes topped with nacho cheese and sour cream.

meals.strInstructions:
To make the chipotle sauce, combine all the ingredients in a blender or food processor and blend until smooth. Set aside.

Combine all the seasonings for the steak in a small bowl. Mix well.

Coat the steak with vegetable oil and season it thoroughly with the spice mixture, ensuring even coverage.

Heat a cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the steak to your desired doneness. Remove it from the heat and let it rest briefly before cutting it into small, bite-sized strips. Wipe out the skillet with a paper towel.

In a medium bowl, toss together the Colby-Jack and mozzarella cheese.

Place the cleaned skillet over medium-high heat. Place one tortilla in the skillet. On one half of the tortilla, layer 1/2 cup of shredded cheese and a quarter of the seasoned steak pieces. Drizzle with chipotle sauce. Fold the other half of the tortilla over the fillings to create a half-moon shape. Cook until the cheese melts and the tortilla becomes golden brown. Flip and cook the other side until crispy. Repeat with the remaining tortillas.
meals.strDescription: This homemade version of Taco Bell's famous Steak Quesadilla features seasoned sirloin, melty cheese, and spicy chipotle sauce in a crispy tortilla.
meals.strIngredient2: [Spicy Chipotle Sauce] mayonnaise Duke's brand recommended
meals.strIngredient3: [Spicy Chipotle Sauce] chipotle peppers in adobo sauce
meals.strIngredient8: [Spicy Chipotle Sauce] freshly squeezed lime juice

meals.strMeal: Taco Bell Caramel Apple Empanada – Easy Copycat Recipe
meals.strInstructions:
Thaw the Goya Empanadas.

In a small saucepan, add apple pie filling, two tablespoons of water, and 3 tablespoons of caramel sauce. Heat over medium heat until the caramel sauce blends in. Then turn off the heat.

Make the glaze by combining the powdered sugar, milk, and vanilla in a bowl. Mix until the glaze is runny.

Preheat vegetable shortening to 350 degrees. Heat enough shortening to cover 3 inches deep in a heavy bottomed pot like a Dutch oven.

Dip your fingers into water and run your finger around the edge of the empanada disk. Spoon about 1 ½ tablespoons of filling into each empanada shell. Then fold over the disk and press the edges of the empanada shell together. Then use a fork to crimp the two edges together.

Complete this for all 10 disks.

Fry two or three at a time, for about 2 minutes on each side, remove from the hot shortening, and place onto a wire rack.

Brush a thin layer of glaze over the empanada while it is hot. Serve immediately.
meals.strDescription: Taco Bell caramel apple empanada is a tasty dessert you can make at home with this easy copycat recipe.

meals.strMeal: Taco Bell Nacho Fries – Easy Copycat Recipe
meals.strInstructions:
If you have a spice grinder, use it to process the spices for the french fry seasoning into a finer powder. If you don't have a spice grinder, combine the spices in a small bowl and mix well. Store the spice blend in a saltshaker or another shaker. Leftovers can use for tacos or another batch of fries.

Combine all the ingredients for the Taco Bell nacho cheese sauce in a small pot and heat on low until the cheese melts. Stir to combine.

Fill a large pot with vegetable oil to a depth of 4 inches. Heat the oil to 350°F.

Fry the fries for 6 to 8 minutes or until crispy. Remove the fries from the oil and place them on a wire rack resting on a baking sheet.

Sprinkle the fries liberally with the seasoning blend and serve with a small bowl of nacho cheese sauce.
meals.strDescription: Enjoy Taco Bell Nacho fries when you make them at home.
meals.strIngredient4: [French Fry Seasoning] garlic powder (do not use garlic salt)
meals.strIngredient5: [French Fry Seasoning] onion powder (do not use onion salt)
meals.strIngredient6: [Taco Bell Nacho Cheese Sauce] salted butter
meals.strIngredient7: [Taco Bell Nacho Cheese Sauce] whole milk
meals.strIngredient8: [Taco Bell Nacho Cheese Sauce] American cheese
meals.strIngredient9: [Taco Bell Nacho Cheese Sauce] Tabasco jalapeño sauce or juice from a jar of jalapeño slices for nachos
meals.strIngredient11: [French Fries] Ore-Ida Extra Crispy Fast Food Fries frozen

meals.strMeal: Homemade Taco Bell Breakfast Crunchwrap (Ready in 20 Minutes)
meals.strInstructions:
Prepare scrambled eggs by breaking three large eggs into a bowl and whisking them together with a fork. Pour eggs into a non-stick skillet over medium heat that you have sprayed with non-stick spray.

Season eggs with salt and pepper, and stir eggs in pan until they have cooked thoroughly. Remove from burner and set eggs aside. Use a large skillet over medium heat to warm tortillas. Lay tortilla in the skillet, and warm on each side for about 30 seconds. You want the tortilla very pliable.

To build the crunch wrap, start by adding 1/4 cup cooked hash browns or 1 cooked hash brown patty. Add half of the eggs, 2 tablespoons of the Taco Bell sauce, 1 tablespoon cheese, and two pieces of bacon crumbled.

To close Crunch Wrap, flip the side closest to you to the center, then flip the right and left side to the center. Finish by closing the top of the crunch wrap by closing the right and left side to the center. You will end up with a five-sided wrap.

Spray the skillet you used to heat the tortilla with some non-stick spray, heat for about 30–40 seconds on medium heat and then flip the wrap and heat on the other side. Both sides should be golden brown.
meals.strDescription: This copycat Taco Bell Breakfast Crunchwrap features crispy hashbrowns, fluffy eggs, melty cheese, and bacon wrapped in a toasted tortilla.
meals.strIngredient4: hash browns (or 2 fried hash brown patties)

meals.strMeal: Taco Bell Enchirito Easy Copycat Recipe
meals.strInstructions:
Assembly: 4 flour tortillas; 1 cup refried beans, heated; 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese; 1/4 cup chopped white onions; sliced black olives (optional).

In a small bowl, combine all the ingredients for the beef, except for the ground chuck itself, and mix well.

Crumble the ground chuck into a large skillet (preferably nonstick) and brown, stirring well. Remove from the heat and drain the grease from the beef.

Return the beef to the pan and stir in the spice mix and 3/4 to 1 cup of water. Simmer uncovered on medium-low heat for 20 minutes, until most of the moisture has cooked away. Remove the pan from the heat before the meat is completely dry.

To make the sauce, combine all the ingredients for the sauce in a saucepan and mix well. Simmer at a very low temperature for 15 to 20 minutes. Remove from the heat and let cool.

Preheat the oven to 350°F.

To assemble the Enchirito, spread 1/4 of the heated refried beans onto a tortilla, followed by 1/4 of the ground beef. Roll up the tortilla and place it seam-side down in an ovenproof dish coated with non-stick spray. Repeat with remaining tortillas. Cover with the prepared sauce, cheese, chopped onions, and black olives, if desired.

Place the Enchiritos in the preheated oven for about 15 minutes, or until the cheese melts.
meals.strDescription: The best of a burrito and enchilada combined! Seasoned beef and beans wrapped in tortilla, smothered in red sauce and cheese.
meals.strIngredient20: [Sauce] garlic salt, paprika, sugar, cayenne pepper
meals.strMeasure20: 1/2 tsp garlic salt; 1/4 tsp paprika; 1/4 tsp sugar; 1/4 tsp cayenne

meals.strMeal: Taco Bell Cinnamon Twists – Easy Copycat Recipe
meals.strInstructions:
Combine the sugar and cinnamon in a bowl and stir.

Heat the oil to 350°F in a deep fryer.

Place the duros into the fryer, about 15 at a time. Nothing will happen for the first few seconds. Then they will suddenly puff up. Continue cooking for 5 seconds after they have puffed up.

Remove the duros from the oil and transfer them to a wire rack to drain.

Sprinkle the duros liberally with cinnamon and sugar.
meals.strDescription: Taco Bell Cinnamon Twists are easy to make at home with this copycat recipe. Enjoy this tasty Mexican sweet treat for a light dessert or snack.

meals.strMeal: Taco Bell Crunchy Tacos – Easy Copycat Recipe
meals.strInstructions:
Beef filling: In a small bowl, combine all the ingredients except the meat, and mix well. Crumble the ground beef into a large skillet (preferably nonstick) and brown, stirring well. Remove from the heat. Drain excess grease from the meat. Stir in the spice mix and 3/4 to 1 cup water. Simmer on medium-low heat for 20 minutes, until most of the moisture has cooked away. Remove from heat before the meat is completely dry.

Tacos: If you like, you can refresh the taco shells in the oven at 350°F for 7 to 10 minutes. To assemble the tacos, spoon a few tablespoons of the meat into each taco shell. Top with lettuce, cheese, tomatoes, and sour cream, if desired. Serve immediately.

Tips: Heat taco shells at 350°F for 3–5 minutes before filling for extra crispness. After browning beef, drain in a colander and let sit 2–3 minutes before adding seasonings. Mix spices in a separate bowl first for even distribution. Don’t skip the masa harina for authentic texture (corn flour works in a pinch). Avoid overfilling shells.
meals.strTags: Copycat,Taco Bell,Taco Bell Recipes,Taco Bell Crunchy Tacos,Main Course
meals.strDescription: The perfect copycat recipe for Taco Bell's famous crunchy tacos with seasoned beef.

meals.strMeal: Copycat Taco Bell Piña Colada Frutista Freeze
meals.strInstructions:
Place all the ingredients into a blender.

Blend until the ice has been crushed.

Pour into a glass.

Top with the lime slice.

Tips: Chill soda and piña colada mix beforehand; use fresh ice; pulse then blend to reduce air pockets; serve immediately; blend less for chunkier ice; pre-chill glasses 15 minutes for a colder drink.
meals.strTags: Copycat,Taco Bell,Taco Bell Frutista Freeze,Drinks,Pina Colada,Frutista
meals.strDescription: This refreshing frozen drink combines the tropical flavors of piña colada with fizzy lemon-lime soda for a perfect warm-weather treat.
meals.strIngredient3: Sierra Mist or other lemon-lime soda

meals.strMeal: Taco Bell Nacho Fries BellGrande – Easy Copycat Recipe
meals.strInstructions:
Toppings for the platter: 1/2 cup guacamole; 1/2 cup sour cream; 1/2 cup chopped tomatoes; optional roasted corn kernels, chopped green onions, and pickled sliced jalapeños.

Taco Bell ground beef: Prepare the seasoning blend by adding all of the beef spices (except the meat) to a small bowl and stir well. Set aside. Crumble the ground chuck into a large skillet (preferably nonstick) and brown, stirring well. Cook over medium-high for about 9 to 10 minutes, or until the ground beef has been cooked through. Drain fat from meat. Place the pan back on the heat, add the seasoning blend and 3/4 cup of water, turn the heat down to low, and allow the ground beef to simmer while you prepare the remaining ingredients.

Nacho fries seasoning: If you have a spice grinder or a mini food processor, process spices to grind them more finely; if not, skip this step. Store spice blend in a salt shaker or another shaker (leftovers are great on tacos or another batch of fries).

Cook the fries following the oven or air fryer directions on the package. When the fries have finished cooking, sprinkle them liberally with the Nacho Fries seasoning blend.

Nacho cheese: Combine all cheese sauce ingredients in a small pot; heat on low until the cheese melts, stir to combine.

To serve: Place the fries on a large platter. Cover with nacho cheese and add the ground beef. Top with guacamole, sour cream, chopped tomatoes, pickled jalapeño peppers, and any other toppings you desire.
meals.strTags: Copycat,Taco Bell,Taco Bell Nacho Fries Bellgrande,Main Course
meals.strDescription: Crispy seasoned fries topped with savory taco meat, creamy nacho cheese sauce, and fresh toppings. This homemade version of Taco Bell's famous Nacho Fries BellGrande is quick, easy, and perfect for any occasion!
meals.strIngredient10: [Taco Bell Ground Beef] dried minced onion
meals.strIngredient11: [Taco Bell Ground Beef] beef bouillon powder
meals.strIngredient16: [Nacho Cheese] Tabasco jalapeño sauce or juice from jalapeño slices for nachos
meals.strIngredient19: [Nacho Fries Seasoning] chili powder, garlic powder, onion powder (do not use garlic or onion salt)
meals.strIngredient20: [Fries] Ore-Ida Extra Crispy Frozen Fast Food Fries

meals.strMeal: McDonald's McRib Sandwich – Easy Copycat Recipe
meals.strInstructions:
Place the cubed pork, cold water, sugar, and salt into a food processor. Process until the meat is smooth and sticky, resembling ground pork.

Divide the processed pork into four portions, each weighing about 4 ounces. Moisten your hands with cold water to prevent sticking and form each portion into a roughly 7x3-inch rectangular patty.

Place the patties between two pieces of parchment paper on a baking sheet. Freeze until completely solid, about 2 hours, to ensure the patties hold their shape during cooking.

Preheat a griddle or cast-iron skillet over high heat until it is very hot, but not yet smoking. Place the frozen pork patties directly onto the hot griddle. Cook for about 3 to 4 minutes per side, until golden brown and cooked through (an internal temperature of 145°F for pork that you ground from a pork butt). Remove the patties from the griddle and let them cool for a few minutes.

While the patties are cooling, spread 1/2 tablespoon of softened butter on the cut side of each hoagie roll. Place the rolls cut side down on the hot griddle until lightly browned, about 1 minute.

Pour the barbecue sauce into a large, shallow bowl. Using tongs, dip each pork patty into the sauce, ensuring both sides are fully coated. Let any excess sauce drip back into the bowl.

To build the sandwiches, place a pork patty onto the bottom half of a toasted hoagie roll. Top the patty with 2 pickle slices and about 2 tablespoons of sliced onions. Cover with the top bun and serve immediately.
meals.strDescription: A homemade version of the McDonald's McRib, made with juicy pork patties, tangy barbecue sauce, pickles, and onions on a soft roll. Includes about 2 hours freezing time for the patties.
meals.strIngredient1: boneless pork butt (pork shoulder or Boston butt), cut into 1-inch cubes
meals.strIngredient7: Kraft Original Slow Simmered Barbecue Sauce

meals.strMeal: McDonald's Caramel Frappe – Easy Copycat Recipe
meals.strInstructions:
In a blender, combine the coffee, milk, ice, and caramel syrup. Blend until smooth.

Pour the mixture into a glass and top with whipped cream and caramel sauce.
meals.strDescription: This copycat McDonald's Caramel Frappe tastes just like the original! Made with strong coffee, whole milk, ice, caramel syrup, whipped cream, and caramel sauce, you can enjoy this coffeehouse treat at home for a fraction of the price. Ready in just 5 minutes!

meals.strInstructions:
Sift the all-purpose flour and corn flour into a large bowl. Add the sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt and mix until well combined.

In a small bowl, beat the eggs until well blended. Whisk in the water, vegetable oil, and maple flavor.

Add the egg mixture to the flour mixture in a slow, steady stream, mixing as you pour. Stir until just combined. Do not overmix—it's OK if there are some small flour pockets. Let the mixture stand for 15 minutes.

Meanwhile, to make the syrup, combine the sugar and water in a small saucepan. Bring the mixture to a simmer over medium heat. When the sugar is dissolved, add the dark corn syrup, imitation maple flavor, and imitation butter flavor. Simmer until the mixture is thick enough to coat the back of a spoon, 1 to 2 minutes. Remove the mixture from the heat and set aside. It will continue to thicken as it cools.

Heat a skillet or griddle over medium-low heat and brush with vegetable oil. When it is hot, pour the pancake batter onto the skillet 1/4 cup at a time. When the pancakes begin to show tiny bubbles on top, flip them over. Continue to cook until golden brown on both sides. Serve warm with syrup and butter, if desired.
meals.strDescription: Make McDonald's famous fluffy hotcakes at home with corn flour for extra tenderness. Includes homemade hotcake syrup recipe too! Batter rests 15 minutes before cooking.

meals.strMeal: McDonald's Big Mac – Easy Copycat Recipe
meals.strInstructions:
In a bowl, season the ground chuck with salt and pepper. Shape the meat into 10 relatively thin patties.

Heat a griddle to 350°F. Place the patties on the griddle and cook for 3 to 4 minutes on one side, adding an extra dash of salt and pepper while cooking.

Flip the burgers and cook for an additional 3 to 4 minutes, until the juices from the meat run clear.

Spread the softened butter on the cut sides of the buns and place them on the griddle until the bread begins to brown. Flip the middle buns and allow them to toast on both sides.

Assemble the burgers in the following order: bottom bun, Big Mac sauce, onions, lettuce, cheese, hamburger patty, middle bun, Big Mac sauce, onions, lettuce, hamburger patty, two or three pickle slices, and finally the top bun.
meals.strDescription: Make a homemade McDonald's Big Mac with two beef patties, special sauce, lettuce, pickles, cheese, and a triple sesame seed bun.

meals.strMeal: McDonald's Bacon Ranch McCrispy – Easy Copycat Recipe
meals.strInstructions:
To make the dressing, combine the buttermilk, mayonnaise, and Hidden Valley Original Ranch Seasoning and Salad Dressing Mix in a small bowl. Mix well and place in the refrigerator.

Cut the chicken breasts in half horizontally to create thinner cutlets. Season with a bit of salt and pepper.

Set up a breading station: Combine the all-purpose flour, cornmeal, onion powder, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and ground black pepper in a flat dish. Stir until well combined. In another shallow dish, combine the egg and milk and beat until smooth.

Pour the vegetable oil into a deep, heavy-bottomed pot until it reaches a depth of 4 inches. Bring the oil to 350°F over medium-high heat.

While the oil is heating, bread the chicken: Place the chicken into the flour, covering both sides, and shake off the excess. Dip the chicken into the egg mixture and shake off the excess. Then dip the chicken into the flour mixture again. Place the breaded chicken on a wire rack to rest for about 5 minutes before frying. This will help the coating adhere to the chicken.

Fry the chicken breasts, 2 at a time, for 7 to 8 minutes, or until the chicken has browned and reaches an internal temperature of 165°F. Drain the chicken on a clean wire rack.

Slice the potato buns if necessary and brush the cut sides with melted butter. Toast in a skillet over medium-high heat for 1 to 2 minutes, or until the buns are golden brown.

To assemble the sandwiches, spread a generous amount of ranch dressing on the bottom bun and top with a fried chicken cutlet. Add 3 bacon slices followed by 3 pickles. Spread a generous amount of ranch dressing on the top bun and place it on the sandwich.

To make the deluxe version, assemble the sandwich as described above, with the addition of 2 tablespoons of shredded lettuce and 3 tomato slices in between the bacon and pickles.
meals.strDescription: McDonald's Bacon Ranch McCrispy is a tasty fried chicken sandwich great for lunch or dinner.
meals.strIngredient3: [Ranch Dressing] Hidden Valley Original Ranch Seasoning and Salad Dressing Mix

meals.strMeal: Homemade McDonald's Oreo McFlurry (No Soft-Serve Required)
meals.strInstructions:
Place ice cream and milk into a blender, and puree ice cream and milk together.

Crumble Oreo cookies into the blender, then pulse the blender a few times to mix in the cookies.

Pour into a glass and enjoy!
meals.strDescription: Recreate McDonald's famous Oreo McFlurry at home with this easy 3-ingredient recipe - creamy vanilla ice cream blended with milk and Oreo cookies.

meals.strMeal: McDonald's Smoky BLT Quarter Pounder – Easy Copycat Recipe
meals.strInstructions:
Toast the buns in a cast-iron or stainless-steel skillet over medium heat for about 1 minute, or until they brown. Set aside.

To make the smoky sauce, combine the mayonnaise, liquid smoke, and paprika in a small bowl. Mix well and set aside.

Form the meat into 4 equal balls. Place each ball between two sheets of waxed paper or plastic wrap and gently press the meat into patties. Do not press too hard, as the patties may fall apart.

Cook the patties for 3 to 4 minutes per side in the same skillet where you toasted the buns. Season the patties with salt before and after flipping them over in the skillet.

To build the burger, place a bottom bun on a plate. Spread some smoky sauce on the bun. Top with 1 slice of American cheese, followed by 1 burger patty and another slice of American cheese. Cut 2 slices of bacon in half and place the resulting 4 pieces of bacon on top of the cheese. Add 3 or 4 tomato slices, some shredded lettuce, and dill pickle slices. Spread smoky sauce on the top bun and place it on the burger. Repeat for the remaining burgers.
meals.strDescription: Juicy beef patties, crispy bacon, fresh toppings, and a smoky sauce recreate McDonald's Smoky BLT Quarter Pounder at home.

meals.strMeal: McDonald's Egg White Delight – Easy Copycat Recipe
meals.strInstructions:
Toast the wheat English muffins in a toaster.

In a small skillet over medium heat, cook Canadian bacon until heated through and slightly browned. Remove the bacon from the skillet.

Separate the eggs. Save the yolks for another recipe.

Whisk the egg whites.

Spray a bit of non-stick spray in the skillet.

Pour egg whites into the skillet and reduce the heat to low.

Slowly cook the egg whites, stirring as they cook. Season with salt and pepper if desired.

Remove the egg whites from the skillet and divide them into 2 portions.

Place the egg whites on the bottom of the English muffins.

Place a slice of cheese and Canadian bacon on top of the egg whites.

Cover the sandwiches with English muffin tops.
meals.strDescription: Make McDonald's Egg White Delight at home! This healthy breakfast sandwich has egg whites, Canadian bacon, and cheese on a whole wheat English muffin.

meals.strMeal: Chick-fil-A Chicken Minis – Easy Copycat Recipe
meals.strInstructions:
Preheat the oven to 300°F.

Carefully place your rolls on a pan and cover them with aluminum foil. Bake for 15 minutes or until lightly browned.

In a small microwave-safe bowl, heat the butter in 10-second increments until fully melted. Add honey and brown sugar to the melted butter and stir until combined.

When the rolls are done, remove from oven and coat the tops evenly with the honey butter mixture using a silicone basting brush.

Preheat air fryer to 390°F.

Add chicken nuggets to the air fryer in a single layer and cook for 5 minutes.

Place rolls back into the oven uncovered for 5 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool.

Once the rolls have cooled, remove them from the pan and place on a separate plate or serving tray. Remove nuggets from the air fryer as well.

Using a butter knife, make a horizontal cut halfway through each roll and open. Place a chicken nugget inside each roll.

Drizzle more honey on top of the chicken minis if desired. Keep warm until ready to serve.
meals.strDescription: Make Chick-fil-A Chicken Minis at home with soft honey butter rolls and crispy chicken for a perfect breakfast treat.
meals.strIngredient5: Member's Mark Southern Style Chicken Bites (or similar)

meals.strInstructions:
Place the chicken into a large mixing bowl with pickle juice. Cover and refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours. Then drain the chicken and pat dry.

Set up a dredging station for the chicken: Beat the egg, milk, and hot sauce in a medium bowl. In another medium bowl, mix the flour, powdered sugar, salt, pepper, paprika, and cayenne pepper.

Heat the oil to 350°F in a heavy-duty pot over medium heat.

Working one chicken breast at a time, dunk one butterflied chicken breast into the egg mixture and shake off any excess. Then dredge in the flour mixture, covering completely. Immediately place the chicken into the oil and fry for 3 to 4 minutes on each side until golden brown. Then remove from the oil and let drain on paper towels. Repeat this process for each chicken breast. Be sure to fry each chicken breast immediately after dredging.

Butter the cut side of the brioche buns, and toast them cut-side down in a separate skillet over medium-low heat.

Assemble the sandwiches by placing one piece of fried chicken on each bottom bun. Add 2 pickle slices over each piece of chicken and cover with the top bun. You can also make this a deluxe sandwich by adding lettuce, tomato, and pepper jack cheese.
meals.strTags: Copycat,Chick-fil-A,Chick Fil A Recipes,Spicy Chicken Sandwich,Main Course
meals.strDescription: You can make Chick-fil-A spicy chicken sandwich at home with this easy copycat recipe.
meals.strIngredient2: pickle juice (from a 32-ounce jar of pickle chips)
meals.strIngredient16: [Optional deluxe] iceberg or green leaf lettuce

meals.strInstructions:
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.

Brush the chicken breasts with 1 teaspoon of olive oil and season them with salt and pepper. Grill for 5 to 7 minutes on each side. When the chicken breasts have finished cooking, chop them into small pieces and set aside.

To make the egg roll filling, place the remaining olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and sauté the red peppers until just tender. Add the green onions, corn, black beans, spinach, pickled jalapeños, and taco seasoning to the skillet. Mix well and sauté until heated through.

Place equal portions of filling onto the tortillas. Then add equal portions of chicken to each tortilla and top with cheese and cilantro. Fold in the ends of the tortilla and roll them up very tightly. Pin with toothpicks to secure.

Add vegetable oil to a large pot until it reaches a depth of 4 inches. Heat the oil to 350°F and deep-fry the egg rolls until they are golden brown, about 7 to 8 minutes. When golden, remove them from the oil and place them on a wire rack.

To make the avocado ranch dressing, combine the dry ranch dressing mix with the mayonnaise and buttermilk. Add the mashed avocado and pulse the mixture in a blender until just blended.

Serve egg rolls topped with chopped tomatoes, onions, and cilantro alongside the avocado ranch dressing.
meals.strDescription: Recreate Chili's famous Southwestern Egg Rolls at home! Crispy flour tortillas stuffed with grilled chicken, black beans, corn, spinach, and cheese, served with a creamy avocado ranch dipping sauce.

meals.strInstructions:
Cut potatoes into 3/8-inch cubes.

Place the potato cubes in a bowl and add enough water to cover the potatoes. Soak for 5 minutes.

Melt the butter in a large pot over medium heat.

When the butter has melted, add the all-purpose flour. Cook on medium heat for about 1 minute. The mixture should become fragrant and smell like pie dough.

Add the chicken stock and heavy cream. Stir until the soup thickens.

Drain the potatoes and add them to the pot.

Season with salt and ground white pepper.

Cook until the potatoes are fork tender, about 30 minutes.

Serve garnished with crumbled bacon, chopped green onions or chives, and shredded cheese.
meals.strDescription: Recreate Chilis' creamy Baked Potato Soup at home! A rich, hearty soup made with russet potatoes in a buttery cream broth, topped with bacon, chives, and cheddar cheese. Makes one gallon.

meals.strInstructions:
Mix all dry ingredients (flour, seasoned salt, black pepper, and garlic powder) together.

Cut the top 1/4 off the onion (the top has the stem). Then peel the onion but make sure the root stays intact.

Carefully slice the onion from the top stopping about 1/2 inch above the root (take care not to cut through the root). Slice the rest of the onion like a pie.

Soak the onion in ice-cold water for about 30 minutes until the onion's petals open up and bloom.

Heat oil to 350 degrees.

Drain the onion and dip in flour mixture and dust the onion to cover it thoroughly.

Dip onion in buttermilk and back in flour mixture.

Place the onion in the hot oil and fry until golden. Oil should cover onion.

When done, drain well and place the fried onion on a plate.

Cut the center out of the onion.

For the dipping sauce, mix together the sour cream, ketchup, seasoned salt, ground red pepper, horseradish, and paprika. Serve the sauce in a small ramekin in the middle of the onion blossom. Garnish with paprika and a dash of red pepper.
meals.strDescription: Recreate Chili's famous Awesome Blossom at home! A whole onion sliced into a blooming flower shape, double-dipped in seasoned flour and buttermilk, then fried golden and served with a creamy horseradish dipping sauce.

meals.strInstructions:
Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Place the butter in the skillet and swirl it around. Place the hamburger buns cut-side down in the melted butter and toast for about 60 seconds. Remove the buns from the skillet.

Form the ground chuck into 4 patties and place them in the skillet. Use a spatula to press down on the hamburger patties. Then take a large soup can that has been wrapped in aluminum foil and press each meat patty down onto the skillet. Cook for about 3 to 5 minutes on each side, seasoning each side with salt and pepper while cooking. Top each patty with a slice of cheese.

To assemble the burgers, place the mustard on the bottom bun, followed by the pickles, shredded lettuce, tomatoes, and red onions. Add the burger patty and cover with the top bun. Serve immediately.
meals.strDescription: Recreate the classic Chilis at home! A smashed ground chuck patty on a toasted brioche bun, topped with cheddar cheese, mustard, dill pickles, shredded lettuce, tomatoes, and red onion.

meals.strInstructions:
Place 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large pot. Season chicken breast with salt. Cook the chicken breast over medium heat for about 6 to 7 minutes on each side until fully cooked. Remove chicken from the pot, and when cool to the touch, shred the chicken.

Place remaining tablespoon of vegetable oil in the same pot where the chicken was cooked. Sauté garlic and onion until the onion is translucent. Add celery and cook for 2 to 3 minutes more.

Add tomato paste and stir well. Sauté for about 1 minute stirring constantly, then add chicken stock.

Add chipotle peppers, hominy, green chilies, diced tomatoes, and shredded chicken. Cook until the soup has heated through.

Add a squeeze of lime juice and about 1 tablespoon of chopped cilantro.

If desired, use corn chips or slice a few corn tortillas thin and fry them in vegetable oil until very crisp.

Garnish soup with fried corn tortilla strips, chopped cilantro, and shredded cheese if desired.
meals.strDescription: Recreate Chili's famous Chicken Enchilada Soup at home! A smoky, hearty soup with shredded chicken, hominy, green chilies, and chipotle peppers in a rich tomato-based broth, topped with crispy tortilla strips and cheese.

meals.strInstructions:
Preheat pellet smoker to 225 degrees Fahrenheit.

In a medium bowl, combine the sugar, salt, pepper, minced onion, garlic powder, cayenne, and paprika. Whisk together.

Place your ribs, with the bottom facing up, on your baking sheet. Remove the membrane from the back of the ribs.

Drizzle a bit of vegetable oil (around 2 tablespoons) on the back of the ribs and rub it all over.

Sprinkle about 1/6 of the spice mixture on the back of each rack of ribs and rub it in thoroughly.

Flip the ribs and repeat the oil and spice process, dividing the remaining seasoning mixture between the two racks.

Place an 8x8 pan of water to the back of your smoker and then place your racks of ribs in the smoker.

Cook for 3 hours at 225 degrees, spraying every half an hour with apple cider vinegar. Spray them just enough to make them shiny.

Place foil on your baking sheet, making sure that the foil is about 5 inches longer than the ribs on each side.

Place your ribs on the foil, generously squirt with apple cider vinegar, seal it tightly, and continue to bake at 225 degrees for 2 more hours.

Remove the ribs from the foil, smother with BBQ sauce, and place them back in the smoker without the foil, and smoke for 1 more hour.

For the BBQ sauce, add all the wet ingredients to a medium boiling pot. Using an immersion blender, blend the ingredients until smooth. Add the rest of the ingredients, stir, and simmer for 30 to 45 minutes. The longer you simmer, the thicker it will get.
meals.strDescription: Recreate Chili's famous Baby Back Ribs at home! Slow-smoked baby back pork ribs seasoned with a bold dry rub, then finished with a rich homemade chipotle BBQ sauce. Smoked low and slow for 6 hours of fall-off-the-bone perfection.

meals.strInstructions:
In a pitcher or large measuring cup, combine the masa harina with 1 quart of the water. Stir until all lumps dissolve.

In a large pot, combine the oil, chicken base, onions, cumin, chili powder, granulated garlic, salt, and cayenne. Cook, stirring occasionally, until onions are soft and translucent, about 5 minutes.

Add masa harina mixture to the onions and bring to a boil. Once it starts to bubble, cook for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring constantly. (This will eliminate any raw taste from the masa harina.)

Stir in the remaining 3 quarts of water and the tomatoes. Let the soup return to a boil, stirring occasionally.

Add the cheese. Cook, stirring occasionally until the cheese melts.

Add the chicken and heat through.
meals.strDescription: Recreate Chilis' Chicken Enchilada Soup at home using the restaurant's masa harina base! A thick, creamy soup loaded with seasoned chicken, crushed tomatoes, and melted American cheese in a masa-thickened broth. Makes a large batch.

meals.strInstructions:
Pour the margarita mix over the chicken breasts and marinate for 2 hours in the refrigerator.

When ready to prepare, drain and season the chicken with salt and black pepper. Discard the marinade.

Heat a grill to 450°F (medium-high).

Grill the chicken until the internal temperature reaches 165°F, turning halfway through grilling.

If you do not have a grill, heat a cast iron skillet over medium-high heat. When it reaches temperature, spray the skillet with oil. Cook the chicken breast on each side until the internal temperature reaches 165°F, about 5 to 7 minutes on each side.

To serve margarita grilled chicken like Chili's, place the grilled chicken breast on top of black beans, Mexican rice, and tortilla strips, and top with pico de gallo.
meals.strDescription: Recreate Chili's Margarita Grilled Chicken at home! Tender chicken breasts marinated in margarita mix, grilled to perfection, and served over black beans, Mexican rice, and tortilla strips with pico de gallo.

meals.strInstructions:
Place the jalapeños and onions in a food processor. Process for just a few seconds.

Add both cans of tomatoes, garlic salt, cumin, and sugar. Process until everything is well blended, but do not puree.

Place in a container, cover, and chill well before serving.
meals.strDescription: Recreate Chili's famous restaurant-style salsa at home! A quick blended salsa made with Rotel, whole tomatoes, jalapeños, and cumin — ready in minutes and best served chilled.

meals.strInstructions:
Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Place the butter in the skillet and swirl it around. Place the hamburger buns cut-side down in the melted butter and toast for about 60 seconds. Remove the buns from the skillet.

Form the ground chuck into 4 patties (8 ounces each) and place them in the skillet. Use a spatula to press down on the hamburger patties. Then take a large soup can that has been wrapped in aluminum foil and press down on each patty. Cook for about 3 to 5 minutes on each side, until the patties reach your desired level of doneness. Season each side with salt and pepper while cooking.

To assemble the burgers, place a slice of cheese on the bottom bun. Add the burger patty, another slice of cheese, 4 pickles, and 1 tablespoon of red onions. Then add the ketchup and mustard, and cover with the top bun. Serve immediately.
meals.strDescription: Recreate Chilis' Big QP Burger at home! A hearty 8-ounce smashed ground chuck patty on a toasted brioche bun, stacked with two slices of cheddar, dill pickles, red onion, ketchup, and mustard.

meals.strInstructions:
Heat the Velveeta and chili together in a skillet or saucepan over low heat until melted, stirring often.

For the most accurate texture, puree the cooked dip in a blender before serving.
meals.strDescription: Recreate Chilis' Beef Skillet Queso at home with just 2 ingredients! Velvety Velveeta melted together with hearty Hormel no-bean chili for a rich, crowd-pleasing dip.

meals.strInstructions:
Cook bacon in a large skillet and drain on a wire rack. Wipe out the skillet, reserving bacon grease if desired. When the bacon has cooled, break into 2 to 3 inch pieces.

For the jalapeño ranch sauce, place the ranch dressing and pickled jalapeños into a blender. Puree until smooth. The sauce will taste better the longer it sits.

For the sautéed onions, add butter to a large skillet. When the butter has melted, add diced onion and cook until translucent. Remove and set aside.

Prepare the burgers by placing ground chuck into a bowl. Add the salt and freshly ground black pepper and mix well.

Divide the seasoned ground beef into 8 portions. Place patties into the skillet without overcrowding. Cook for 3 to 4 minutes on each side until browned. When the burger has browned, add a 1/4 slice of American cheese to each patty.

Toast the slider buns in butter in the skillet for about 60 seconds.

Build the sliders by placing cooked onions and bacon on the bottom bun. Top with the burger patty and drizzle with jalapeño ranch sauce. Add the top bun and serve immediately.
meals.strDescription: Recreate Chili's Big Mouth Bites Sliders at home! Mini brioche bun sliders loaded with seasoned ground chuck, crispy bacon, sautéed onions, American cheese, and a creamy homemade jalapeño ranch sauce.

meals.strInstructions:
Grease the ramekins with butter. Then dust the buttered ramekins with cocoa powder.

In a small microwave-safe bowl, combine the baking chocolate and butter.

Microwave for 30 seconds, stir, and repeat until the chocolate and butter are fully melted.

Whisk together the whole eggs, egg yolks, and sugar until lighter in color and foamy.

Add the melted chocolate to the egg mixture.

Stir in the vanilla extract, salt, and flour.

Pour the batter into the ramekins.

Cover the dishes with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes or up to 4 hours.

Preheat the oven to 350°F and bake for approximately 12 to 15 minutes. The tops will be firm but the insides will be molten.

Unmold the cakes onto a plate.

Place a scoop of vanilla ice cream on top of the lava cake.

Pour Magic Shell over the vanilla ice cream.

Serve immediately.
meals.strDescription: Recreate Chilis' famous Chocolate Molten Lava Cake at home! A rich, warm chocolate cake with a gooey molten center, topped with a scoop of vanilla ice cream and drizzled with Magic Shell.

meals.strInstructions:
Cut lime into wedges.

Rim the glass with 1 wedge of lime.

Dip the wet margarita glass rim into margarita salt.

In a Boston shaker, add the tequila, brandy, and orange liqueur. Fill with ice.

Shake well. Pour over fresh ice in the salt-rimmed margarita glass.

Add a splash of lime juice and garnish with a lime wedge.
meals.strDescription: Recreate Chilis' famous Presidente Margarita at home! A premium margarita made with Sauza Commemorativo Añejo Tequila, Presidente Brandy, and Patrón Citronge, shaken and served over ice in a salt-rimmed glass.

meals.strInstructions:
Place the vegetable oil, onion, and 1 1/2 tablespoons of jalapeño in a medium-sized pot over medium-low heat. Sauté until the onion becomes translucent.

Add the cheeses and half-and-half. Reduce the heat to low and stir until the cheese melts.

When the cheese has melted, add the tomatoes and 1 tablespoon of cilantro. Mix well and remove from the heat.

Garnish with the remaining cilantro and chopped jalapeños and serve with tortilla chips.
meals.strDescription: Recreate Applebees' creamy Queso Blanco at home! A rich white cheese dip made with American and Monterey Jack cheeses, sautéed jalapeños, onion, tomato, and cilantro — perfect with tortilla chips.

meals.strInstructions:
Preheat oven to 400°F. Butter 4 small (6-ounce) ramekins, then dust with sugar.

In the top of a double boiler over simmering water, melt the 4 ounces semisweet chocolate with 4 ounces butter. Whisk occasionally until smooth and uniform.

Meanwhile, whisk together the whole eggs, egg yolks, and 1/4 cup sugar until light and fluffy.

Pour the melted chocolate mixture into the egg mixture and stir very quickly. Add the flour and salt and blend until just mixed.

Pour batter into the prepared ramekins. Set the ramekins on a baking sheet and bake for 8 minutes — the cake centers will still be soft.

Invert each lava cake onto a dessert plate. They will slip out of the ramekins in a few seconds.

To make the drizzle toppings, place the white and semisweet chocolates in separate bowls and add 1 teaspoon of shortening to each bowl. Melt in the microwave in 15-second increments, stirring between each, until fully melted.

To assemble, top each lava cake with a scoop of vanilla ice cream. Drizzle the white chocolate over the cake, then drizzle the semisweet chocolate on top.
meals.strDescription: Recreate Applebees' famous Triple Chocolate Meltdown at home! A warm, gooey semisweet chocolate lava cake topped with vanilla ice cream and drizzled with both white and dark chocolate.

meals.strInstructions:
To make the Mexi-Ranch sauce, combine the sour cream, ranch dressing, salsa, and taco seasoning in a small bowl. Stir to combine and set aside.

Preheat the oven to 200°F.

Divide the shredded cheddar cheese evenly among 8 tortillas. Cover the cheese with the 8 remaining tortillas.

In a large non-stick skillet over medium heat, cook the quesadillas for about 2 minutes on each side until golden brown and the cheese is melted. Remove from the skillet and keep warm in the oven while you cook the burgers.

Combine the ground chuck, salt, and black pepper in a bowl and use your hands to incorporate. Divide the beef into 4 patties.

Wipe out the skillet with a paper towel and cook the burgers over medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes on each side.

To assemble, place each burger patty on top of a quesadilla. Top each patty with 2 slices of pepper jack cheese, 2 slices of cooked bacon, pico de gallo, shredded lettuce, and Mexi-Ranch sauce.
meals.strDescription: Recreate Applebees famous Quesadilla Burger at home! A seasoned ground chuck patty served on a crispy quesadilla, topped with pepper jack cheese, applewood bacon, pico de gallo, shredded lettuce, and a creamy Mexi-Ranch sauce.

meals.strInstructions:
Preheat the oven to 350°F and spray an 8x8-inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray.

In a large mixing bowl, combine the cream cheese, milk, and alfredo sauce. Mix well with an electric hand mixer until well blended. Add the remaining ingredients (except for the tortilla chips) and mix with a large spoon or rubber spatula.

Pour the mixture into the prepared baking dish, using the spoon or spatula to gently flatten the top and create an even layer.

Bake for 55 to 60 minutes, checking periodically, and serve warm with tortilla chips.
meals.strDescription: Recreate Applebeess' famous Spinach and Artichoke Dip at home! A rich, cheesy baked dip made with cream cheese, garlic alfredo sauce, artichoke hearts, spinach, and three melted cheeses, served warm with tortilla chips.

meals.strInstructions:
Preheat the oven to 425°F and prepare a large baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray.

Prepare a dredging station by mixing the flour, salt, pepper, and garlic powder in a shallow bowl; beating the eggs, milk, and hot sauce in another small bowl until fully blended; and placing the finely crushed Flamin' Hot Cheeto crumbs in a third shallow bowl.

Dredge one chicken wing at a time in the flour mixture, coating evenly and fully. Then dip the wing into the egg mixture, coat the wing in Flamin' Hot Cheetos, and place on the prepared baking sheet. Repeat for all wings.

Bake the wings for 18 to 20 minutes. Allow them to cool for about 5 minutes before serving with additional hot sauce, ranch dressing, and/or celery sticks if desired.
meals.strDescription: Recreate Applebees' Flamin' Hot Cheeto Wings at home! Crispy baked chicken wings triple-dredged in seasoned flour, egg wash, and crushed Flamin' Hot Cheetos for a fiery, crunchy coating.

meals.strInstructions:
Place all the dressing ingredients (honey, rice vinegar, mayonnaise, Dijon mustard, sesame oil, and salt) in a small bowl and mix well. Refrigerate in a covered container until ready to serve.

Set up a dredging station for the fried chicken: in a small bowl, mix the flour, salt, pepper, and garlic powder. In a separate small bowl, beat the egg and milk until fully combined. Place the panko bread crumbs in a third shallow bowl.

In a heavy-duty pot, heat the peanut oil to 350°F over medium heat.

Working one at a time, dredge each chicken strip in the flour mixture, coating evenly. Dunk the chicken strip into the egg mixture, coating completely. Then coat the chicken strip with the bread crumbs. Repeat for all the chicken strips.

Fry the breaded chicken strips in the peanut oil, flipping halfway through, until each side is golden brown. Remove from the oil and allow to drain on paper towels. When cooled, dice into bite-sized pieces.

In a large mixing bowl, combine the romaine, red cabbage, carrots, almonds, green onions, and chow mein noodles. Top with the breaded chicken and dressing. Toss before serving or allow each serving to be tossed individually.
meals.strDescription: Recreate Applebees' famous Oriental Chicken Salad at home! Crispy panko-breaded chicken tenders over a colorful salad of romaine, red cabbage, carrots, almonds, green onions, and chow mein noodles, tossed in a sweet honey-sesame dressing. Note: also includes 5 ounces chow mein noodles in the salad.

meals.strMeal: Applebees Bourbon Street Chicken and Shrimp
meals.strInstructions:
Combine all cajun seasoning ingredients (garlic powder, onion powder, celery seed, smoked paprika, black pepper, dried oregano, and dried parsley) in a bowl and divide in half.

Season both sides of the chicken with half of the cajun seasoning, rubbing it into the meat to help it adhere.

Place shrimp in a medium mixing bowl. Add 1 tablespoon of olive oil and the remaining half of cajun seasoning to the shrimp. Toss to coat.

Heat a large frying pan over medium heat. Add 2 tablespoons of butter. Once melted, add the mushrooms and onions. Season with a pinch of salt and pepper and cook until softened, about 10 minutes, stirring often.

Heat a cast iron skillet over low heat and add a splash of olive oil to coat the bottom — this will be used to keep finished components warm and for serving.

Transfer the cooked onions and mushrooms to the skillet. Do not drain or wipe the frying pan.

Increase the frying pan's heat to high. Add a splash of olive oil. Sear the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes per side or until the internal temperature reaches 165°F. Place the chicken on top of the caramelized onions in the skillet.

Add 1 tablespoon of butter to the frying pan. Once melted, add the shrimp and sear for 1 minute per side. Transfer to the skillet next to the chicken.

Lower the frying pan heat to medium. Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute. Add the chicken broth to deglaze the pan, scraping up any browned bits. Add the remaining butter. Once melted, stir in the fresh parsley and cook for 5 minutes.

Pour the parsley butter sauce over the chicken and shrimp and serve.
meals.strDescription: Recreate Applebees' Bourbon Street Chicken and Shrimp at home! Cajun-seasoned seared chicken and shrimp served on a sizzling skillet over caramelized onions and mushrooms, finished with a rich garlic parsley butter sauce.

meals.strInstructions:
Preheat the oven to 375°F and place 4 metal taco stands on a large baking sheet with 3 corners of each stand pointing upright.

Drape the wonton wrappers over the taco stands so that each wonton forms a taco shape. Gently spray each wonton wrapper with nonstick cooking spray and bake for 6 to 8 minutes, until golden brown with a bubbled crust.

In a medium skillet over medium heat, combine all the chicken ingredients (diced chicken, hoisin sauce, sesame oil, soy sauce, garlic, and ginger). Toss well and cook for 5 to 7 minutes, until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F. Remove from the pan and discard any excess sauce.

Place all the Asian slaw ingredients (coleslaw mix, ramen noodles, green onions, sesame oil, apple cider vinegar, soy sauce, and honey) into a large mixing bowl and toss to combine.

To assemble the tacos, place 1 to 2 spoonfuls of chicken into the bottom of each wonton shell. Top with the slaw mix. Add sweet chili sauce, sesame seeds, and chopped cilantro before serving.
meals.strDescription: Recreate Applebees' famous Crispy Chicken Wonton Tacos at home! Crispy baked wonton shells filled with hoisin-glazed chicken and a crunchy Asian slaw, topped with sweet chili sauce, sesame seeds, and cilantro.
